entries.title: Genesis 5:1
segments: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made he him;

entries.title: Genesis 5:2
segments: male and female created he them, and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.

entries.title: Genesis 5:3
segments: And Adam lived a hundred and thirty years, and begat [a son] in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth:

entries.title: Genesis 5:4
segments: and the days of Adam after he begat Seth were eight hundred years: and he begat sons and daughters.

entries.title: Genesis 5:5
segments: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.

entries.title: Genesis 5:6
segments: And Seth lived a hundred and five years, and begat Enosh:

entries.title: Genesis 5:7
segments: and Seth lived after he begat Enosh eight hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters:

entries.title: Genesis 5:8
segments: and all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years: and he died.

entries.title: Genesis 5:9
segments: And Enosh lived ninety years, and begat Kenan.

entries.title: Genesis 5:10
segments: and Enosh lived after he begat Kenan eight hundred and fifteen years, and begat sons and daughters:

entries.title: Genesis 5:11
segments: and all the days of Enosh were nine hundred and five years: and he died.

entries.title: Genesis 5:12
segments: And Kenan lived seventy years, and begat Mahalalel:

entries.title: Genesis 5:13
segments: and Kenan lived after he begat Mahalalel eight hundred and forty years, and begat sons and daughters:

entries.title: Genesis 5:14
segments: and all the days of Kenan were nine hundred and ten years: and he died.

entries.title: Genesis 5:15
segments: And Mahalalel lived sixty and five years, and begat Jared:

entries.title: Genesis 5:16
segments: And Mahalalel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters:

entries.title: Genesis 5:17
segments: and all the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety and five years: and he died.

entries.title: Genesis 5:18
segments: And Jared lived a hundred sixty and two years, and begat Enoch:

entries.title: Genesis 5:19
segments: and Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:

entries.title: Genesis 5:20
segments: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years: and he died.

entries.title: Genesis 5:21
segments: And Enoch lived sixty and five years, and begat Methuselah:

entries.title: Genesis 5:22
segments: and Enoch walked with God after he begat Methuselah three hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:

entries.title: Genesis 5:23
segments: and all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years:

entries.title: Genesis 5:24
segments: and Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.

entries.title: Genesis 5:25
segments: And Methuselah lived a hundred eighty and seven years, and begat Lamech:

entries.title: Genesis 5:26
segments: and Methuselah lived after he begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years, and begat sons and daughters.

entries.title: Genesis 5:27
segments: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years: and he died.

entries.title: Genesis 5:28
segments: And Lamech lived a hundred eighty and two years, and begat a son:

entries.title: Genesis 5:29
segments: and he called his name Noah, saying, This same shall comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, [which cometh] because of the ground which Jehovah hath cursed.

entries.title: Genesis 5:30
segments: And Lamech lived after he begat Noah five hundred ninety and five years, and begat sons and daughters:

entries.title: Genesis 5:31
segments: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years: and he died.

entries.title: Genesis 5:32
segments: And Noah was five hundred years old: And Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
